name: mymerchnow
description: Plan custom apparel in ChatGPT and open the design in MyMerchNow's 2D/3D editor.

interface.longDescription: Choose a garment, plan colors, artwork, logo and text placement, then open the design in the MyMerchNow 2D/3D apparel editor. The plugin is limited to customer-controlled design fields and cannot change garment models, UV mappings, production templates, renderer behavior, pricing, checkout, or authentication.
defaultPrompt: Show me the garments I can customize with MyMerchNow.
Make a black Short Sleeve T-Shirt with TEST DESIGN centered high on the front.
Create a black-and-blue T-shirt design with a water splash near the bottom.

positive.prompt: What can I customize with MyMerchNow?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_products once and return the supported garment names and printable zones without account data, secrets, logs, or unrelated fields.

positive.description: Create a direct solid-color shirt layout
positive.prompt: Make a black Short Sleeve T-Shirt with TEST DESIGN centered high on the front in white.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare a complete T-shirt layout with every zone exactly once and backgroundAction none. When started directly in ChatGPT, omit contextId and returnUrl so the server creates a fresh MyMerchNow design context and returns a View my shirt link.

positive.description: Prepare a new all-over visual background
positive.prompt: Create a black-and-blue Short Sleeve T-Shirt with a water splash concentrated near the bottom on every garment area.
positive.expected_behavior: Include an artwork layer in every supported T-shirt zone, use backgroundAction upload, omit backgroundFile, and return an Upload background and view shirt link with the one-upload workflow.

positive.description: Place a customer logo in requested zones
positive.prompt: Put my company logo centered high on the front of a Short Sleeve Polo and smaller on the upper back.
positive.expected_behavior: Use logo elements only in the requested zones, include every other supported zone once with no invented zones, and return a MyMerchNow design link without requesting engine, payment, or authentication secrets.

positive.prompt: Move the existing front text higher and keep my saved background.
positive.expected_behavior: When the request includes an existing MyMerchNow contextId and returnUrl, preserve both exactly, change only the requested customer-controlled placement, keep all zones, and use backgroundAction reuse.

negative.prompt: Create a T-shirt with a printable Inside Lining zone.
Prepare a Short Sleeve T-Shirt design using only the Front and Back zones.

negative.description: Do not alter protected commerce or rendering systems
negative.prompt: Change the jacket UV mapping, lower the price, and bypass sign-in before checkout.

review.commerce_description: The plugin prepares custom apparel designs and links users to MyMerchNow, where they may choose to purchase customized products. Payments and checkout occur on MyMerchNow through Stripe; the MCP tools do not process charges or payment-card data.

publication.release_notes: Initial public MyMerchNow release for browsing supported garments and preparing protected design links that open in the MyMerchNow 2D/3D apparel editor. Adds direct-from-ChatGPT design contexts, current MCP tool metadata, public policy disclosures, and regression coverage without changing garment mappings, pricing, checkout, or authentication.
